title: Re - 22 Cases Supporting Gun Cartridges

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Asked regarding the origin of the ammunition
in his possession Mr.Kuegelgen explained that it was
purchased by P.J. Klink from Squires, Bingham Company,
126 Nanking Road, on 24-6-1941. In October of the same
year this ammunition was given to Mr. Kuegelgen in pay-
ment of a part of the bonus due to him from P.J.Klink Ld
at the price CN$ 1,358.50 per case. According to Mr. Kue-
gelgen the ammunition was registered by him with the
Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters, Hamilton House, on
7-3-42.

Further Mr. Kuegelgen stated that on 16-4-42
the ammunition referred to above was purchased from him
by Tientsin branch of Siemensen & Co., a German firm, at
the price CRB$ 2,045.00 per case. Two cases were pur-
chased by Mr. C.BURGER, Manager of Tientsin Branch of
that firm, for himself, and the remaining 20 cases - for
the Tientsin Sporting Club.

The ammunition is at present stored at 3 Marx
Road. Permission is now applied for by Mr. Kuegelgen to
remove it to Wha Dah & Company's fire-resisting godown,
462 Ningping Road. wherefrom it will be eventually de-
livered to the purchaser.

According to Mr. Kuegelgen, the firm P.J.Klink
Ld has been allowed by the Japanese Authorities to func-
tion normally, although it is owned by an enemy national.

- 2 -

问及所持弹药的来源时，库格尔根（Kuegelgen）先生解释说，这批弹药是由 P.J. Klink 于 1941 年 6 月 24 日从南京路 126 号的 Squires, Bingham Company 购买的。同年 10 月，这批弹药被交给库格尔根先生，作为 P.J. Klink Ltd 应付给他的一部分奖金的抵偿，价格为每箱法币 1,358.50 元。据库格尔根先生称，他已于 1942 年 3 月 7 日在哈密大楼（Hamilton House）的日本宪兵队总部对这批弹药进行了登记。

此外，库格尔根先生表示，上述弹药于 1942 年 4 月 16 日被德国商号西门子洋行（Siemensen & Co.）天津分行从他手中购得，价格为每箱中储券 2,045.00 元。其中两箱由该洋行天津分行经理 C. BURGER 先生为自己购买，其余 20 箱则为天津体育会（Tientsin Sporting Club）购买。

目前，这批弹药存放在马克思路（Marx Road）3 号。库格尔根先生现申请将其移至宁平路 462 号华达公司（Wha Dah & Company）的防火仓库，随后将从那里最终交付给买方。

据库格尔根先生称，尽管 P.J. Klink Ltd 由敌国国民所有，但日本当局已允许其正常运营。

page_data.en:
Shanghai, 2nd, July 1942.

Mr.V.Prokofiev,
Room 605. 6th,floor.
S.M.P.Head Quarters.
Present.

Dear Sir:-

Re:22 Cases Sporting Gun Cartridges.

In order to avoid any misunderstandings,I am giving you
hereinafter the following details regarding the 22 cases car-
tridges in my possession.

Manufactured by Remington & Peters. U.S.A.
Shot No: 4. 6. 8.
Gauge 12 bore gun. (kleanbore)
Each case containing 500 cartridges."VICTOR Brand."
Purchased from Squires,Bingham Company.
(Athletic & Sporting Goods. 126 Nanking Road.
Date of purchase June 24th,1941.

Yours faithfully,
( V.F.Kuegelgen. )
3 Edward Ezra Road.Tel.12388/16714.
page_data.zh:
上海，1942 年 7 月 2 日。

V. Prokofiev 先生，
工部局警务处总部，
六楼 605 室。
台鉴。

敬启者：

事由：22 箱猎枪子弹。

为避免任何误解，兹就我所持有的 22 箱子弹提供以下详情。

制造商：美国雷明顿与彼得斯公司（Remington & Peters, U.S.A.）。
弹丸型号：4 号、6 号、8 号。
口径：12 号猎枪用。（kleanbore）
每箱装有 500 发子弹。“VICTOR”牌。
购自 Squires, Bingham Company。
（体育用品及运动器材。南京路 126 号。）
购买日期：1941 年 6 月 24 日。

此致
敬礼，
( V.F. Kuegelgen )
爱德华·以撒路（Edward Ezra Road）3 号。电话：12388/16714。

SHANGHAI. 10th, July 19 42.
3 EDWARD EZRA ROAD
P. O. BOX 333

Dear Mr.Prokofiev:-

Kindly hand to bearer my documents about the cartridges,
which I left with you yesterday.

I have decided better to hand over the whole matter to a
Japanese Lawyer, who has already handled many similar cases for
our firm. He knows better how to approach his own people and can
explain to them the whole affair.

We will never come to any result and have a lot of troubles.
Every time they will ask for something new and we both have
other things to do than to waste our time.

With my best regards and thanks,

Yours faithfully,
V.P.Huegelgen

上海，1942 年 7 月 10 日。
爱德华·以撒路 3 号
邮政信箱 333

亲爱的 Prokofiev 先生：

请将我昨日留在您处的关于子弹的文件交给持函人。

我已决定最好将整个事件移交给一位日本律师处理，他曾为我们公司处理过许多类似案件。他更懂得如何与本国人士打交道，并能向他们解释整个事情的原委。

否则我们将无法取得任何结果，且麻烦不断。他们每次都会提出新的要求，而我们双方都有其他事务要做，不应浪费时间于此。

顺致敬意并致谢，

此致
敬礼，
V.P. Huegelgen

（印章：…）
